description: Rules for automated logic validation of agent outputs

rationale.posterior_tolerance: 5% absolute difference acceptable due to rounding
rationale.lr_tolerance: 15% relative difference acceptable for LR mapping variations
rationale.extreme_lr: Flag combined LR outside 0.01-100 range for review

observable_implications.description: Observable implications to verify at Gate 2

architect_implications.A1: Official Participation in ISDA/FINOS working groups
architect_implications.A2: Named Individual Contributors in CDM repositories
architect_implications.A3: Public Announcements of CDM pilots or production
architect_implications.A4: Technical Investment signals (job postings, conference talks)

pragmatist_implications.P2: Absence from CDM Forums and working groups
pragmatist_implications.P3: Traditional Technology Focus without CDM integration
pragmatist_implications.P4: Regulatory Compliance Focus via vendor solutions
pragmatist_implications.P6: Peer Differentiation from known CDM adopters

adjustment_consistency.description: Rules for checking adjustment consistency across banks

stage_validation_mapping.description: Which validations apply to which stages

violation_severity.description: Default severity levels for violation types

state_validation.description: Controls how state file validation failures are handled (Gap 5 fix)

modes.strict: Raise exception on validation errors (production default)
modes.warn: Log warning but save state anyway (development/debugging)

rationale.default_strict: STRICT mode prevents silent data corruption in production
rationale.env_override: Allows temporary mode switch without config changes
rationale.selective_failures: Some checks are warnings, others are errors

usage_notes: All validations are non-blocking by default; violations queue for review
Severity levels: ERROR (requires attention), WARNING (informational), INFO (logged only)
Tolerances may need adjustment based on observed false positive rates
Observable implications list should match templates/observable-implications.md
